Per id: the take that was kept (seconds, LUFS, peak, local problems) and attempts = audio requests made for it (at most 2). finish / tokens = the answer's finishReason and output token count; cap = the maxOutputTokens sent (audio is about 25 tokens per second; MAX_TOKENS = the cap was reached). _usage counts every request: requests = audio generation requests (direct calls + Batch API items, retries included), httpAttempts = HTTP requests sent (rate-limit resends included; a 429 answer makes no audio), retries = second requests after a failed local check / an empty or error answer, capHits = takes that stopped at the output cap. _verify = the last local check of all files on disk (--verify). stt = an offline open-source speech recognizer (tools/voice_en_stt.py --lang en; no API): report-only, except a line said twice (repeated), which counts as a length far off the text and may use the one retry.

v_berna_lute_04.speaker: berna
v_berna_lute_04.text: Retell them all, and complete your Chronicle. That will be the end of your training.

stt.heard: retell them all and complete your chronicle. That will be the end of your training.

v_berna_lute_05.speaker: berna
v_berna_lute_05.text: Start wherever you like. Retell them on your own feet, in your own order.

stt.heard: Start wherever you like. Retail them on your own feet in your own order.

v_berna_p2_01.speaker: berna
v_berna_p2_01.text: Ah, yes. I have something important to tell you.

stt.heard: Ah, yes, I have something important to tell you.

v_berna_p2_02.speaker: berna
v_berna_p2_02.text: Lately, all over the land, old tales have been vanishing.

stt.heard: Lately, all over the land, old tales have been vanishing.

v_berna_p2_03.speaker: berna
v_berna_p2_03.text: Songs whose next verse won't come. Festivals no one can explain. That's all I hear these days.

stt.heard: Songs whose next verse won't come, festivals no one can explain, that's all I hear these days.
We storytellers call it the blank.

v_berna_p2_05.speaker: berna
v_berna_p2_05.text: Half the words on our village's Telling Stone have gone white, too.

stt.heard: Half the words on our village's telling stone have gone white too.

v_berna_p2_06.speaker: berna
v_berna_p2_06.text: And the lighthouse in the port town of Pharos — its fire had been failing for three nights. Yesterday, they say, it finally went out.

stt.heard: and the lighthouse in the port town of pharaohs, its fire had been failing for three nights. Yesterday, they say, it finally went out.

v_berna_p2_07.speaker: berna
v_berna_p2_07.text: That lighthouse has an old tale, the Keeper's Song. It, too, is going blank.

stt.heard: That lighthouse has an old tail, the keeper's song, it too is going blank.

v_berna_p2_08.speaker: berna
v_berna_p2_08.text: But don't go alone. Find companions at the Sea Breeze Tavern in Pharos.

stt.heard: but don't go alone. Find companions at the Sea Breeze Tavern in Faros.

v_berna_p2_10.speaker: berna
v_berna_p2_10.text: Please go. It will be your first task as an apprentice storyteller.

stt.heard: please go. It will be your first task as an apprentice storyteller.

v_berna_prologue_01.speaker: berna
v_berna_prologue_01.text: Good morning. Today is an important day.

stt.heard: Good morning. Today is an important day.

v_berna_prologue_02.speaker: berna
v_berna_prologue_02.text: I need to write you down in the storytellers' register.

stt.heard: I need to write you down in the Storytellers Register.

v_berna_prologue_03.speaker: berna
v_berna_prologue_03.text: Now then, my apprentice. Tell me once more what sort of child you were.

stt.heard: Now then, my apprentice, tell me once more, what sort of child you were?

v_berna_prologue_04.speaker: berna
v_berna_prologue_04.text: When you're ready, come to my lectern. There's something I must tell you.

stt.heard: When you're ready, come to my lectern. There's something I must tell you.

v_berna_roa_01.speaker: berna
v_berna_roa_01.text: This young lady... have we met somewhere...?

stt.heard: This young lady, have we met somewhere?

v_berna_roa_02.speaker: berna
v_berna_roa_02.text: Welcome home. ...You've written so much, to come this far.

stt.heard: Welcome home you've ridden so much to come this far

v_berna_roa_03.speaker: berna
v_berna_roa_03.text: The First Chronicle is at the top of Biblia's Great Archive. So my teacher told me.

stt.heard: The first chronicle is at the top of Biblia's great archive, so my teacher told me.

v_berna_roa_04.speaker: berna
v_berna_roa_04.text: Take this with you. It's the necklace my teacher gave me when I was young.

stt.heard: Take this with you. It's the necklace my teacher gave me when I was young.

v_berna_seat_01.speaker: berna
v_berna_seat_01.text: An old custom. Whose seat it is... I've forgotten.

stt.heard: an old custom. Whose seat it is, I've forgotten.

v_dorga_ash_01.speaker: dorga
v_dorga_ash_01.text: In the middle of the bout, two young women came down onto the sand and sang. Friend and foe alike lowered their swords.

v_dorga_ash_02.speaker: dorga
v_dorga_ash_02.text: ...What they sang, I cannot recall. From that night on, I have called this tournament a "trial."

v_dorga_ash_03.speaker: dorga
v_dorga_ash_03.text: ...Let's keep a seat for the singers. Until the day comes that we can carve their two names.

v_elm_forest_01.speaker: elm
v_elm_forest_01.text: ...I remember. I swore to protect this forest.

stt.heard: I remember. I swore to protect this forest.

v_elm_forest_02.speaker: elm
v_elm_forest_02.text: The night of fire, a thousand years ago... Before the burning forest, I took this tree as my dwelling, and sealed the fire.

stt.heard: The night of fire. A thousand years ago. Before the burning forest I took this tree as my dwelling and sealed the fire.

v_elm_forest_03.speaker: elm
v_elm_forest_03.text: The village folk promised to guard my sleep with their song.

stt.heard: The village folk promised to guard my sleep with their song.

v_elm_forest_04.speaker: elm
v_elm_forest_04.text: When the song died, I forgot my promise. I closed the forest and led people astray...

stt.heard: When the song died, I forgot my promise, I closed the forest and led people astray.

v_elm_forest_06.speaker: elm
v_elm_forest_06.text: The forest paths shall close no more. The woodcutters, too, will soon be home in their village.

stt.heard: The forest paths shall close no more. The woodcutters too will soon be home in their village.

v_fine_ash_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_ash_01.text: Burning out and being forgotten are not the same thing.

stt.heard: Burning out and being forgotten are not the same thing.

v_fine_ending_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_ending_01.text: It's time for me, too, to return to the story.

stt.heard: It's time for me, too, to return to the story.

v_fine_ending_02.speaker: fine
v_fine_ending_02.text: ...Keep telling it. About me, and about your journey.

stt.heard: Keep telling it about me and about your journey.

v_fine_forest_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_forest_01.text: The heart of the tale lies deep in these roots. ...Something is eating them.

stt.heard: The heart of the tail lies deep in these roots. Something is eating them.

v_fine_isles_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_isles_01.text: As long as someone is waiting, the story does not end.

stt.heard: As long as someone is waiting, the story does not end.

v_fine_lighthouse_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_lighthouse_01.text: A light that has lost its words is won back with words.

stt.heard: A light that has lost its words is one back with words.

v_fine_marsh_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_marsh_01.text: Fog has no shape of its own, so it can become anyone.

stt.heard: Fog has no shape of its own, so it can become anyone.

v_fine_naming_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_naming_01.text: My last light — I give it to you.

stt.heard: My last light, I give it to you.

v_fine_oblivion_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_oblivion_01.text: This is where stories that never end sink.

stt.heard: This is where stories that never end sink.

v_fine_oblivion_02.speaker: fine
v_fine_oblivion_02.text: That dragon eats the endings of stories and makes the same tale repeat forever.

stt.heard: That dragon eats the endings of stories and makes the same tale repeat forever.

v_fine_opening_02.speaker: fine
v_fine_opening_02.text: This is a story that was nearly forgotten.

stt.heard: This is a story that was nearly forgotten.

v_fine_opening_03.speaker: fine
v_fine_opening_03.text: And the story of the storyteller who told it anew.

stt.heard: and the story of the storyteller who told it anew.

v_fine_roa_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_roa_01.text: Berna. Will you listen to the story of your apprentice?

stt.heard: Therena, will you listen to the story of your apprentice?

v_fine_roa_02.speaker: fine
v_fine_roa_02.text: ...It's all right. Remember me someday, whenever you can.

stt.heard: It's alright. Remember me someday, whenever you can.

v_fine_roa_03.speaker: fine
v_fine_roa_03.text: ...I'll be waiting for you on the island.

stt.heard: I'll be waiting for you on the island.

v_fine_shades_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_shades_01.text: Shades of the heroes who slew the Demon King on the eastern continent, three hundred years ago...

stt.heard: shades of the heroes who slew the Demon King on the Eastern continent 300 years ago.

v_fine_shades_02.speaker: fine
v_fine_shades_02.text: Their names were forgotten, but their story remained.

stt.heard: Their names were forgotten, but their story remained.

v_fine_snow_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_snow_01.text: It isn't the dragon's body that's frozen. It's its heart.

stt.heard: It isn't the dragon's body that's frozen, it's heart.

v_fine_song_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_song_01.text: Reach to the sea's end, O light, and show the homeward boats the way

stt.heard: Reach to the seas and, O light, and show the homeward boats the way.

v_fine_song_02.speaker: fine
v_fine_song_02.text: Reach to the sea's end, O light, and show the homeward boats the way

stt.heard: Reach to the seas end, O light, and show the homeward boats the way.

v_fine_t3_02.speaker: fine
v_fine_t3_02.text: ...I'm Fina. At least remember my name.

stt.heard: I'm Fina. At least remember my name.

v_fine_t8_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_t8_01.text: I can tell you now. I am Fina — the storyteller who wrote the First Chronicle, a thousand years ago.

stt.heard: I can tell you now, I am Fina, the storyteller who wrote the first chronicle a thousand years ago.

v_fine_t8_02.speaker: fine
v_fine_t8_02.text: When the world was still a white dark, I told the first story and put that dark to sleep.

stt.heard: When the world was still a white dark, I told the first story and put that dark to sleep.

v_fine_t8_03.speaker: fine
v_fine_t8_03.text: Across the sea, they say, crests sealed away a Demon King. On this continent, a story became the seal.

stt.heard: Across the sea, they say, Crusts sealed away a demon king. On this continent, a story became the seal.

v_fine_t8_04.speaker: fine
v_fine_t8_04.text: That dark — the Hollow King — is beginning to wake.

stt.heard: That dark, the hollow king, is beginning to wake.

v_fine_t8_05.speaker: fine
v_fine_t8_05.text: Now that all eight pages are here, we can clear the fog over the inland sea.

stt.heard: Now that all 8 pages are here, we can clear the fog over the inland sea.

v_fine_t8_06.speaker: fine
v_fine_t8_06.text: To Roa. Let's go home, to the place where it all began.

stt.heard: to Roa. Let's go home to the place where it all began.

v_fine_windhill_01.speaker: fine
v_fine_windhill_01.text: ...So the wind remembers the song, too.

stt.heard: So the wind remembers the song too.

v_glen_ship_01.speaker: glen
v_glen_ship_01.text: No fog at sea... will lead me... ...The rest... it won't come...

stt.heard: No, no foggets see, will leave me, the rest, it won't come.

v_glen_ship_02.speaker: glen
v_glen_ship_02.text: Where was I... sailing home to? Who was waiting...? I can't remember... I can't remember!

stt.heard: Where was I sailing home to? Who was waiting? I can't remember. I can't remember!

v_glen_ship_03.speaker: glen
v_glen_ship_03.text: ...Marina. Aye, I promised her I'd come home.

stt.heard: I promise to her I'd come home.

v_glen_ship_04.speaker: glen
v_glen_ship_04.text: So the cape light was her. Sixty years I kept her waiting. ...Let's go home.

stt.heard: So the Cape Life was her. 60 years, I kept her waiting. Let's go home.

v_guardian_mine_01.speaker: guardian
v_guardian_mine_01.text: ...You who forgot the oath. You who dug below the Seventh Level.

v_guardian_mine_02.speaker: guardian
v_guardian_mine_02.text: By my pact with the Smith God, I guard this mountain. Depart, or be broken.

v_guardian_mine_03.speaker: guardian
v_guardian_mine_03.text: ...So the oath still lives. Then I shall sleep.

v_hald_snow_01.speaker: hald
v_hald_snow_01.text: A wolf pack! They've surrounded the village!

v_hald_snow_02.speaker: hald
v_hald_snow_02.text: Shut the gates! Men, to the gates!

v_hazal_tomb_01.speaker: hazal
v_hazal_tomb_01.text: ...My name... Give me back my name...!

stt.heard: My name. Give me back my name.

v_hazal_tomb_03.speaker: hazal
v_hazal_tomb_03.text: Hazar... yes. That is my name.

stt.heard: How's our... Yes, that is my name.

v_hazal_tomb_04.speaker: hazal
v_hazal_tomb_04.text: So my people remembered our promise...

stt.heard: So, my people remembered our promise.

v_hazal_tomb_05.speaker: hazal
v_hazal_tomb_05.text: In exchange for water, I gave my name to the spirit of the sand.

stt.heard: In exchange for water, I gave my name to the spirit of the sand.

v_hazal_tomb_06.speaker: hazal
v_hazal_tomb_06.text: While the name is called, the sun-fire shall not die. ...That promise, too, was copied from the stone, and vanished.

stt.heard: While the name is called, the sun-fire shall not die. That promise, too, was copied from the stone and vanished.

v_hazal_tomb_07.speaker: hazal
v_hazal_tomb_07.text: Storyteller. Give my name back once more to the people of the spring.

stt.heard: Storyteller give my name back once more to the people of the spring

v_jorn_snow_01.speaker: jorn
v_jorn_snow_01.text: Good light to you, traveler. I'm Jorn, chief of Yule.

stt.heard: Good luck to you, traveler. I'm Jorn, Chief of U.L.

v_jorn_snow_02.speaker: jorn
v_jorn_snow_02.text: Tonight's the solstice, the festival night. We burn the solstice fire in the great hearth, tell an old tale, and carry both to the peak.

stt.heard: Tonight's the solstice, the festival night. We burn the solstice fire in the great hearth, tell an old tale, and carry both to the peak.

v_jorn_snow_03.speaker: jorn
v_jorn_snow_03.text: We bring fire and a story to the white dragon on the peak, and the dragon calms the blizzards. ...That's our promise.

stt.heard: We bring fire and a story to the white dragon on the peak, and the dragon calms the blizzards. That's our promise.

v_jorn_snow_04.speaker: jorn
v_jorn_snow_04.text: But this year, since autumn, the blizzard hasn't let up for a single day. Our stories aren't reaching the dragon.

stt.heard: But this year, since Autumn, the Blizzard hasn't let up for a single day. Our stories aren't reaching the dragon.

v_jorn_snow_05.speaker: jorn
v_jorn_snow_05.text: Storyteller. Tell us this year's story, here before the fire.

stt.heard: Storyteller, tell us this year's story here before the fire.

v_jorn_snow_06.speaker: jorn
v_jorn_snow_06.text: So that it reaches the dragon on the peak.

stt.heard: so that it reaches the dragon on the peak.

v_jorn_snow_07.speaker: jorn
v_jorn_snow_07.text: Three gates. North, east, west. With our hands alone, we can only hold two.

stt.heard: Three gates. North. East. West. With our hands alone, we can only hold two.

v_jorn_snow_08.speaker: jorn
v_jorn_snow_08.text: Lend us your strength. Choose which gate to defend.

stt.heard: lend us your strength. Choose which gate to defend.

v_kaya_ash_01.speaker: kaya
v_kaya_ash_01.text: The egg is growing cold. I must tell it the tale of the firebird, and yet...

v_kaya_ash_02.speaker: kaya
v_kaya_ash_02.text: Last year I told it to someone from the Archive, and since then... when I try to say it aloud, nothing comes.

v_king_altar_01.speaker: king
v_king_altar_01.text: Without name, without form, I return all things to the Blank.

stt.heard: Without name, without form, I return all things to the blank.

v_king_altar_02.speaker: king
v_king_altar_02.text: Futile. The nameless do not vanish.

stt.heard: Future, the nameless do not vanish.

v_king_altar_03.speaker: king
v_king_altar_03.text: Back again...? The nameless do not vanish.

stt.heard: Back again, living in an aimless, do not vanish.

v_king_archive_01.speaker: king
v_king_archive_01.text: Well done, Lazaro. Your grief was exquisite.

stt.heard: Well done, Lazarus, your grief was exquisite.

v_king_shades_01.speaker: king
v_king_shades_01.text: O heroes from across the sea, whose names were forgotten...

stt.heard: All heroes, all heroes from across the sea, whose names were forgotten.

v_lazaro_archive_02.speaker: lazaro
v_lazaro_archive_02.text: Twenty years ago, in the Sunheir War, I lost my daughter, Mira.

stt.heard: Twenty years ago, in the Sun-Her War, I lost my daughter Mira.

v_lazaro_archive_03.speaker: lazaro
v_lazaro_archive_03.text: Over which legend was the true one... For that.

stt.heard: over which legend was the true one, for that.

v_lazaro_archive_04.speaker: lazaro
v_lazaro_archive_04.text: Once forgotten, the strife and the grief become as though they never were.

stt.heard: Once forgotten, the strife and the grief become as though they never were.

v_lazaro_archive_05.speaker: lazaro
v_lazaro_archive_05.text: That is salvation. ...And still, you write.

stt.heard: That is salvation, and still you write.

v_lazaro_archive_06.speaker: lazaro
v_lazaro_archive_06.text: Then allow me to break that pen of yours.

stt.heard: then allow me to break that pen of yours.

v_lazaro_archive_07.speaker: lazaro
v_lazaro_archive_07.text: ...Why? Her smile, which I should have forgotten... now, of all times...

stt.heard: Why, her smile, which I should have forgotten, now of all times.
Oh, thank you. He's finally come home.

v_mayor_marsh_01.speaker: mayor
v_mayor_marsh_01.text: Then let us hear your accusation. Who took the children?

stt.heard: Then let us hear your accusation. Who took the children?

v_mayor_marsh_02.speaker: mayor
v_mayor_marsh_02.text: The fog...? You claim the fog takes children?

stt.heard: The fog. You claim the fog takes children?

v_mayor_marsh_04.speaker: mayor
v_mayor_marsh_04.text: The fog took the witch's shape and led the children away...

stt.heard: The fog took the witch's shape and led the children away.

v_mayor_marsh_05.speaker: mayor
v_mayor_marsh_05.text: ...We very nearly set fire to an innocent house.

stt.heard: We very nearly set fire to an innocent house.

v_melda_manor_01.speaker: melda
v_melda_manor_01.text: ...I'm sorry, I've startled you. I am Melda. Once, long ago, the mistress of this house.

stt.heard: Oh, I'm sorry! I've startled you. I am Melda. Once, long ago, the mistress of this house.

v_melda_manor_02.speaker: melda
v_melda_manor_02.text: I have not taken any children. The fog is imitating my shape.

stt.heard: I have not taken any children. The fog is imitating my shape.

v_melda_manor_03.speaker: melda
v_melda_manor_03.text: Long ago, when monsters poured out of the marsh fog, I sank seven bells and sealed the fog away with their sound.

stt.heard: Long ago, when monsters poured out of the marsh fog, I sank seven bells and sealed the fog away with their sound.

v_melda_manor_04.speaker: melda
v_melda_manor_04.text: But the townsfolk forgot the bell song, and the bells stopped ringing...

stt.heard: But the townsfolk forgot the bell song, and the bells stopped ringing.

v_melda_manor_05.speaker: melda
v_melda_manor_05.text: Ring the marsh bell for me. This is the bell key. And this is the bell song.

stt.heard: Ring the marsh bell for me, this is the bell key, and this is the bell song.

v_melda_marsh_01.speaker: melda
v_melda_marsh_01.text: Thank you, storyteller. Now the bells will ring again for the town's mornings.

stt.heard: Thank you, storyteller. Now the bells will ring again for the town's mornings.

v_melda_song_01.speaker: melda
v_melda_song_01.text: Ring out, you seven bells, fog, sink to the marsh's floor, morning, come to the town's windows

stt.heard: Ring out, you seven bells. Fog sink to the marsh's floor. Morning come to the town's windows.

v_nadia_desert_01.speaker: nadia
v_nadia_desert_01.text: I'm Nadia. A dancer. Every night I sing and dance the king's song in the square. Listen.

stt.heard: I'm Nadia, a dancer. Every night I sing and dance the King's song in the square. Listen.

v_nadia_desert_02.speaker: nadia
v_nadia_desert_02.text: ...Only the part with the name, I just can't sing. Not my mother, not my grandmother either.

stt.heard: Ugh. Only the part with the name. I just can't sing. Not my mother, not my grandmother either.

v_nadia_desert_03.speaker: nadia
v_nadia_desert_03.text: I heard the king's name was carved in the stones of the tomb. Nobody can go and read it, though.

stt.heard: I heard the king's name was carved in the stones of the tomb. Nobody can go and read it though.

v_nadia_desert_04.speaker: nadia
v_nadia_desert_04.text: You learned the king's name, didn't you? ...Tell me.

stt.heard: You learned the King's name, didn't you? Tell me.

v_nadia_desert_05.speaker: nadia
v_nadia_desert_05.text: Hazar... Yes, it fits perfectly. I'll try singing it.

stt.heard: Hazar. Yes, it fits perfectly. I'll try singing it.

v_nadia_song_01.speaker: nadia
v_nadia_song_01.text: O king who called water to the sea of sand, your name is —... in evening prayers forevermore

stt.heard: O King, who called water to the sea of sand, your name is in evening prayers forevermore.

v_nadia_song_02.speaker: nadia
v_nadia_song_02.text: O king who called water to the sea of sand, your name is Hazar, friend of the sun, in evening prayers forevermore

stt.heard: O King who called water to the sea of sand, your name is Hazar, friend of the sun, in evening prayers forevermore.

v_nemrea_ending_01.speaker: nemrea
v_nemrea_ending_01.text: This is... the first time... my name... has been called...

stt.heard: This is the first time my name has been called.

v_neve_peak_01.speaker: neve
v_neve_peak_01.text: ...Begone... child of man... On this peak, there are no more stories to tell...!

stt.heard: Be gone, child of man. On this peak, there are no more stories to tell.

v_neve_peak_02.speaker: neve
v_neve_peak_02.text: ...Warm. So the children of man had not forgotten me after all.

stt.heard: Warm, so the children of man had not forgotten me after all.

v_neve_peak_03.speaker: neve
v_neve_peak_03.text: I shall calm the blizzards. Storyteller, you have my thanks.

stt.heard: I shall calm the blizzards. Storyteller, you have my thanks.

v_neve_peak_04.speaker: neve
v_neve_peak_04.text: ...Take this with you. One of my scales.

stt.heard: Take this with you, one of my scales.

v_noa_biblia_01.speaker: noa
v_noa_biblia_01.text: You're not from this town, are you? ...Rowell?

stt.heard: You're not from this town, are you? Raul?

v_noa_biblia_02.speaker: noa
v_noa_biblia_02.text: I've sung the song Mira taught me every night... so I'm the only one who hasn't forgotten.

stt.heard: I've sung the song Mira taught me every night, so I'm the only one who hasn't forgotten.

v_noa_biblia_03.speaker: noa
v_noa_biblia_03.text: This is Biblia, the Archive's town. But everyone has forgotten what matters most.

stt.heard: This is Biblioth, the archives town, but everyone has forgotten what matters most.

v_noa_biblia_04.speaker: noa
v_noa_biblia_04.text: The Director's daughter... Mira was my friend. In the war, twenty years ago...

stt.heard: The director's daughter, Miro was my friend, in the war 20 years ago.

v_noa_biblia_05.speaker: noa
v_noa_biblia_05.text: You met the Director...? ...I see. So he remembered Mira again.

stt.heard: You met the director? I see. So he remembered Mira again.

v_noa_biblia_06.speaker: noa
v_noa_biblia_06.text: Mira loved to sing. She used to say, "A name is meant to be called."

stt.heard: Myra loved to sing. She used to say, a name is meant to be called.

v_otto_pharos_01.speaker: otto
v_otto_pharos_01.text: I'm Otto, the lighthouse keeper. The lighthouse fire went out, and I couldn't sleep a wink.

stt.heard: I'm auto. The lighthouse keeper. The lighthouse fire went out, and I couldn't sleep a wink.

v_otto_pharos_02.speaker: otto
v_otto_pharos_02.text: ...What, you'll go to the lighthouse? Alone? Out of the question. Find companions at the Sea Breeze Tavern.

stt.heard: What? You'll go to the lighthouse. Alone? Out of the question. Find companions at the Seabreeze Tavern.

v_otto_pharos_03.speaker: otto
v_otto_pharos_03.text: Oh, you've brought companions. That's another matter, then.

stt.heard: Oh, you've brought companions. That's another matter then.

v_otto_pharos_04.speaker: otto
v_otto_pharos_04.text: I just can't recall the lighthouse's Keeper's Song. Without it, the fire won't light.

stt.heard: I just can't recall the lighthouse's keepers song without it. The fire won't light.

v_otto_pharos_06.speaker: otto
v_otto_pharos_06.text: The lighthouse is south of town, at the tip of the cape. Before you go, let me teach you a thing about fighting.

stt.heard: The Lighthouse is south of town at the tip of the Cape. Before you go, let me teach you a thing about fighting.

v_otto_reward_01.speaker: otto
v_otto_reward_01.text: Reach to the sea's end, O light, and show the homeward boats the way...

stt.heard: Reach to the sea's end, O light, and show the homeward boats the way.

v_otto_reward_02.speaker: otto
v_otto_reward_02.text: This is the lantern I've used since I was young. Please, take it with you.

stt.heard: This is the lantern I have used since I was young. Please, take it with you.

v_otto_reward_03.speaker: otto
v_otto_reward_03.text: When I was young, the lighthouse had a thing called the "morning watch." Now the fire's back, I'll post it again.

stt.heard: When I was young, the lighthouse had a thing called the morning watch. Now the fire is back, I'll post it again.

v_otto_reward_04.speaker: otto
v_otto_reward_04.text: ...Hmm. What was it we watched for, though? I just can't remember.

stt.heard: Hmm. What was it we watched for though? I just can't remember.

v_otto_reward_05.speaker: otto
v_otto_reward_05.text: The lighthouse is lit again! And I remember the Keeper's Song.

stt.heard: The lighthouse is lit again, and I remember the keeper's song.

v_rashid_desert_01.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_desert_01.text: Don't move. We won't take your lives.

stt.heard: Don't move. We won't take your lives.

v_rashid_desert_02.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_desert_02.text: We are the "Sand Hawks." It's water we want. Leave half your water jars.

stt.heard: We are the Sandhawks. It's water we want. Leave half your water jars.

v_rashid_desert_03.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_desert_03.text: ...Good arm. I'm Rashid. I was a soldier of the Sun Alliance, once.

stt.heard: Good arm, I'm Rashid. I was a soldier of the Sun Alliance once.

v_rashid_desert_04.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_desert_04.text: Twenty years ago, the night of the champions' bout... I heard singing. Friend and foe alike stopped.

stt.heard: Twenty years ago, the night of the champion's bout, I heard singing. Friend and foe alike stopped.

v_rashid_desert_05.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_desert_05.text: ...What happened after, I somehow can't recall. Next thing I knew, I was a bandit on the sand.

stt.heard: What happened after I somehow can't recall? Next thing I knew, I was a bandit on the sand.

v_rashid_desert_06.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_desert_06.text: Go. We're heading back to the mesa caves. ...Next time, it won't go like this.

stt.heard: Go. We're heading back to the Mesa Caves. Next time it won't go like this.

v_rashid_hawks_01.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_hawks_01.text: ...So you've come. Caravan dogs. This is our last nest.

stt.heard: So you've come, caravan dogs. This is our last nest.

v_rashid_hawks_02.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_hawks_02.text: This time, I won't hold back!

stt.heard: This time, I won't hold back.

v_rashid_hawks_04.speaker: rashid
v_rashid_hawks_04.text: Take these gloves. ...I'm done with stealing. I'll find another way to feed our people.

stt.heard: Take these gloves. I'm done with stealing. I'll find another way to feed our people.

v_rita_forest_01.speaker: rita
v_rita_forest_01.text: Sleep, lord of the forest, in a thousand rings... No. The next part just won't come to me.

v_rita_forest_02.speaker: rita
v_rita_forest_02.text: I'm Rita, this village's singer. Of the Millennial Tree's song, I can only remember the first verse.

v_rita_forest_03.speaker: rita
v_rita_forest_03.text: Everyone, listen. The song of the Millennial Tree.

v_rowell_biblia_01.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_biblia_01.text: ...This is bad. The whole town is going blank.

stt.heard: This is bad. The whole town is going blank.

v_rowell_biblia_03.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_biblia_03.text: The Great Archive is full of the Director's scribes. The sealed door on the third floor opens with the words in my notebook.

stt.heard: The great archive is full of the director's scribes. The sealed door on the third floor opens with the words in my notebook.

v_rowell_biblia_04.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_biblia_04.text: I'll wait at the town's north gate. Come when you're ready.

stt.heard: I'll wait at the town's north gate. Come when you're ready.

v_rowell_ending_01.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_ending_01.text: Let's go home, Director. ...Tell me about Mira. Please.

stt.heard: Let's go home, director. Tell me about Mira. Please.

v_rowell_prologue_01.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_prologue_01.text: ...An apprentice storyteller. If it's the lighthouse tale, the Archive copied it yesterday.

stt.heard: An apprentice storyteller. If it's the lighthouse tale, the archive copied it yesterday.

v_rowell_prologue_02.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_prologue_02.text: The Archive takes full responsibility for tales. There's no call for storytellers here.

stt.heard: The archive takes full responsibility for tales. There's no call for storytellers here.

v_rowell_roa_01.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_roa_01.text: I'll have a ship sail from Pharos harbor to the island. ...I'm coming too.

stt.heard: I'll have a ship sale from Ferrell's Harbor to the island. I'm coming too.

v_rowell_roa_02.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_roa_02.text: I'll go ahead to the harbor and get a ship ready. We'll meet in Pharos.

stt.heard: I'll go ahead to the harbor and get a ship ready. We'll meet in pharaohs.

v_rowell_seal_01.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_seal_01.text: Sorry to keep you. ...This is the sealed door.

stt.heard: Sorry to keep you, this is the sealed door.

v_rowell_seal_02.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_seal_02.text: "O door of the White Book, open for those who bear a name."

stt.heard: Oh, door of the white book, open for those who bear a name.

v_rowell_t2_02.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t2_02.text: Stop spreading tales around. If the Archive copies and keeps them, that's enough.

stt.heard: Stop spreading tales around. If the archive copies and keeps them, that's enough.

v_rowell_t2_03.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t2_03.text: If words won't make you understand, I'll stop you by force.

stt.heard: If words will make you understand, I'll stop you by force.

v_rowell_t2_04.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t2_04.text: ...Tch. That pen of yours wasn't just luck, it seems.

stt.heard: That pen of yours wasn't just luck, it seems.

v_rowell_t2_05.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t2_05.text: Remember this. A tale can become a chain that binds people.

stt.heard: Remember this, a tail can become a chain that binds people.

v_rowell_t2_06.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t2_06.text: Take it. I don't like owing anyone.

stt.heard: Take it. I don't like owing anyone.

v_rowell_t2_07.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t2_07.text: That's the difference between us. ...Cool your head, storyteller.

stt.heard: That's the difference between us cool your head storyteller

v_rowell_t4_01.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t4_01.text: ...We meet again. I still haven't repaid my debt from last time.

stt.heard: Hm. We meet again. I still haven't repaid my debt from last time.

v_rowell_t4_02.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t4_02.text: ...You heard that? The Director means it.

stt.heard: You heard that? The director means it.

v_rowell_t4_03.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t4_03.text: The Director is trying to build a world without grief. Not that you'd understand.

stt.heard: The director is trying to build a world without grief, not that you'd understand.

v_rowell_t5_01.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t5_01.text: This time, you won't call it luck.

stt.heard: This time, you won't call it luck.

v_rowell_t5_02.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t5_02.text: Why...? The tales you retell will be on people's lips again.

stt.heard: Why the tales you retell will be on people's lips again?

v_rowell_t5_03.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t5_03.text: Why can't you see that they'll sow the seeds of war!

stt.heard: Why can't you see that they'll sow the seeds of war?
Am I really in the right?

v_rowell_t5_05.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t5_05.text: ...I won. So why? I don't feel any better.

stt.heard: I won. So why? I don't feel any better.

v_rowell_t7_01.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t7_01.text: ...Wait. I need to talk to you.

stt.heard: Wait, I need to talk to you.

v_rowell_t7_02.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t7_02.text: Since you beat me, I've been thinking. ...I have my answer.

stt.heard: Since you beat me, I've been thinking. I have my answer.

v_rowell_t7_03.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t7_03.text: The Director knew that when a tale is copied into the White Book, it vanishes from people's hearts.

stt.heard: The director knew that when a tale is copied into the white book, it vanishes from people's hearts.

v_rowell_t7_04.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t7_04.text: He knew, and he had us copy them anyway.

stt.heard: He knew, and he had us copy them anyway.

v_rowell_t7_05.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t7_05.text: I can't remember my own mother's face. Because I copied my diary into the White Book.

stt.heard: I... can't remember my own mother's face, because I copied my diary into the white book.

v_rowell_t7_06.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t7_06.text: Take this. It has the words that open the sealed door of the Great Archive.

stt.heard: Take this. It has the words that open the sealed door of the Great Archive.

v_rowell_t7_07.speaker: rowell
v_rowell_t7_07.text: I'm not going back to the Archive.

stt.heard: I'm not going back to the archive.

v_sentinel_star_01.speaker: sentinel
v_sentinel_star_01.text: ...No. Entry. None without. The names. Of stars. Shall pass...

v_sonja_snow_01.speaker: sonja
v_sonja_snow_01.text: ...The fire's so thin. I add tallow and add tallow, but...

stt.heard: The fire's so thin. I add tallow, and add tallow, but...

v_sonja_snow_02.speaker: sonja
v_sonja_snow_02.text: I'm Sonja. Daughter of the firekeepers' house. I tend the fire in the great hearth.

stt.heard: I'm Sonya, daughter of the Fire Keepers House. I tend the fire in the great hearth.

v_sonja_snow_03.speaker: sonja
v_sonja_snow_03.text: At the festival, we read from the storybook in front of the fire. The same book, every year.

stt.heard: At the festival, we read from the storybook in front of the fire, the same book, every year.

v_sonja_snow_04.speaker: sonja
v_sonja_snow_04.text: But this year, when I opened it... it was blank. Not a single letter was left.

stt.heard: But this year, when I opened it, it was blank, now a single letter was left.

v_sonja_snow_06.speaker: sonja
v_sonja_snow_06.text: I went to cut tonight's notch into the night-counting board. ...But my hand stopped.

stt.heard: I went to cut tonight's notch into the night counting board, but my hand stopped.

v_sonja_snow_07.speaker: sonja
v_sonja_snow_07.text: ...Tonight, the sky is brighter than usual.

stt.heard: Tonight, the sky is brighter than usual.

v_valzard_oblivion_02.speaker: valzard
v_valzard_oblivion_02.text: Three hundred years... forgotten, yet only the fear remained...

stt.heard: Three hundred years, for gone, and only the fear remained.

v_zaid_desert_01.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_desert_01.text: I'm Zaid, master of the caravans. You've seen the notice?

stt.heard: I'm Zaid, master of the caravans. You've seen the notice?

v_zaid_desert_02.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_desert_02.text: We carry offerings to the Tomb Oasis. An old custom. The old spring there is the source of our spring's water.

stt.heard: We carry offerings to the tomb oasis an old custom The old spring there is the source of our Springs water

v_zaid_desert_03.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_desert_03.text: With sandstorms and bandits, we can't send a caravan out. Would you guard us? Three nights of camp, to the oasis.

stt.heard: With sandstorms and bandits, we can't send a caravan out. Would you guard us? Three nights of camp to the Oasis.

v_zaid_desert_04.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_desert_04.text: The star at the world's edge, growing pale... My grandmother called that one "the dawn star."

stt.heard: The star, the world's edge, growing pale. My grandmother called that one the dawn star.

v_zaid_desert_05.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_desert_05.text: ...Dawn. Strange word. Night... breaks? What breaks?

stt.heard: Hmm, dawn. Strange word. Night breaks. What breaks?

v_zaid_desert_06.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_desert_06.text: The spring... the spring is filling!

stt.heard: The spring, the spring is filling.

v_zaid_desert_07.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_desert_07.text: ...This light — it's the color of the "dawn star" in my grandmother's song.

stt.heard: This light, it's the color of the dawn star in my grandmother's song.

v_zaid_song_01.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_song_01.text: Nail-star of the north, star that never moves, be the stake for caravans gone astray

stt.heard: Nail star of the north, star that never moves. Be the stake for Caravan's gone astray.

v_zaid_song_02.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_song_02.text: Seven spring-stars, tip your dipper, scatter the night's dew upon the sand

stt.heard: Seven spring stars, tip your dipper, scatter the night's dew upon the sand.

v_zaid_song_03.speaker: zaid
v_zaid_song_03.text: Star at the world's edge, growing pale... Grandmother called it "the dawn star"

stt.heard: Star at the world's edge, growing pale. Grandmother called it the dawn star.

v_zakuro_ash_01.speaker: zakuro
v_zakuro_ash_01.text: ...I'm done with copying jobs. Leaves a bad taste.

stt.heard: I'm done with copying jobs, leaves a bad taste.

v_zakuro_ash_02.speaker: zakuro
v_zakuro_ash_02.text: I don't read other people's letters. That's the rule I live by.

stt.heard: I don't read other people's letters. That's the rule I live by.
